function extraById(id){return EXTRA_EVENTS.find(e=>e.id===id);}

function mergeEventEffect(label,choiceIndex,extra){
  const ev=EVENTS.find(e=>e.label===label); if(!ev||!ev.choices[choiceIndex])return;
  const e=ev.choices[choiceIndex].effect=ev.choices[choiceIndex].effect||{};
  if(extra.mastery)e.mastery={...(e.mastery||{}),...extra.mastery};
  if(extra.prep)e.prep={...(e.prep||{}),...extra.prep};
  if(extra.fatigue)e.fatigue=(e.fatigue||0)+extra.fatigue;
}

const AFTERMATH_DELAY={
  meme_silent:{days:2},meme_cleanup:{days:2},meme_warn:{days:2},
  loan_direct:{days:3},loan_soft:{days:3},loan_silent:{days:3},
  fakeSign_accept:{days:2},fakeSign_deny:{days:2},fakeSign_explain:{days:2},
  hideScore_admit:{days:2},hideScore_plan:{days:2},hideScore_argue:{days:2},
  cheat_admit:{weeks:1},cheat_deny:{weeks:1},cheat_redo:{days:2},
  joke_ignore:{weeks:1},joke_stop:{weeks:1},joke_apologize:{weeks:1}
};
function queueAftermath(ids){
  if(!ids)return;
  state.pendingAftermaths=Array.isArray(state.pendingAftermaths)?state.pendingAftermaths:[];
  state.pendingAftermaths=state.pendingAftermaths.map(x=>typeof x==="string"?{
    id:x,dueWeek:state.week||1,dueDay:(state.daySerial||0)+1,
    queuedWeek:state.week||1,queuedDay:state.daySerial||0
  }:x);
  (Array.isArray(ids)?ids:[ids]).forEach(id=>{
    if(!id||!AFTERMATH_EVENTS[id])return;
    const delay=AFTERMATH_DELAY[id]||{days:2};
    let dueWeek=(state.week||1)+(delay.weeks||0);
    let dueDay=(state.daySerial||0)+(delay.days||0);
    // 第一章最後一週仍保證能在段考結算前看到後續。
    if(dueWeek>7){dueWeek=7;dueDay=(state.daySerial||0)+2;}
    state.pendingAftermaths.push({
      id,dueWeek,dueDay,
      queuedWeek:state.week||1,
      queuedDay:state.daySerial||0
    });
  });
}
function aftermathDue(item){
  if(!item)return false;
  if(typeof item==="string")return true;
  if((state.week||1)>(item.dueWeek||1))return true;
  if((state.week||1)<(item.dueWeek||1))return false;
  return (state.daySerial||0)>=(item.dueDay||0);
}
function dueAftermathIndex(force=false){
  state.pendingAftermaths=Array.isArray(state.pendingAftermaths)?state.pendingAftermaths:[];
  if(force)return state.pendingAftermaths.length?0:-1;
  return state.pendingAftermaths.findIndex(aftermathDue);
}
function hasDueAftermath(){return dueAftermathIndex(false)>=0;}
function showQueuedAftermath(force=false){
  state.pendingAftermaths=Array.isArray(state.pendingAftermaths)?state.pendingAftermaths:[];
  const i=dueAftermathIndex(force);
  if(i<0)return resumeFlow();
  const item=state.pendingAftermaths.splice(i,1)[0];
  const id=typeof item==="string"?item:item.id;
  if(!id||!AFTERMATH_EVENTS[id])return resumeFlow();
  showEvent(AFTERMATH_EVENTS[id]());
}

function addWarning(n=1){
  state.discipline=state.discipline||{warning:0,minorDemerit:0};
  state.formalConsequences=state.formalConsequences||{fakeSignDemeritApplied:false};
  state.discipline.warning+=n;
}
function addMinorDemerit(n=1){
  state.discipline=state.discipline||{warning:0,minorDemerit:0};
  state.discipline.minorDemerit+=n;
}
function riskFaces(rule){
  const accumulated=Math.ceil(Math.max(0,rule.value(state)));
  return clamp((rule.baseFaces||1)+Math.max(0,accumulated-1),1,5);
}
function riskActive(rule){
  return !state.consequencesDone[rule.id] && rule.value(state)>0;
}
function riskSnapshot(){
  const o={};DICE_RULES.forEach(r=>o[r.id]=Math.max(0,r.value(state)));return o;
}
function markRaisedRisks(before){
  state.riskMeta=state.riskMeta||{};
  state.classId=state.classId||"";
  state.chapter1Review=state.chapter1Review||null;
  state.stats.confidence=state.stats.confidence??55;
  state.discipline=state.discipline||{warning:0,minorDemerit:0};
  state.pendingAftermaths=Array.isArray(state.pendingAftermaths)?state.pendingAftermaths:[];
  DICE_RULES.forEach(r=>{
    const now=Math.max(0,r.value(state)),old=before[r.id]||0;
    if(now>old){
      state.riskMeta[r.id]=state.riskMeta[r.id]||{};
      state.riskMeta[r.id].raisedDay=state.daySerial||0;
    }
  });
}

  if((ev.label||"").includes("群組"))c.push("group");
  if(ev.bg==="bg_classroom")c.push("school");

  if(force)return state.pendingAftermaths.length?0:-1;
  return state.pendingAftermaths.findIndex(aftermathDue);
}
function hasDueAftermath(){return dueAftermathIndex(false)>=0;}
function showQueuedAftermath(force=false){
  state.pendingAftermaths=Array.isArray(state.pendingAftermaths)?state.pendingAftermaths:[];
  const i=dueAftermathIndex(force);
  if(i<0)return resumeFlow();
  const item=state.pendingAftermaths.splice(i,1)[0];
  const id=typeof item==="string"?item:item.id;
  if(!id||!AFTERMATH_EVENTS[id])return resumeFlow();
  showEvent(AFTERMATH_EVENTS[id]());
}
function addWarning(n=1){
  state.discipline=state.discipline||{warning:0,minorDemerit:0};
  state.formalConsequences=state.formalConsequences||{fakeSignDemeritApplied:false};
  state.discipline.warning+=n;
}
function addMinorDemerit(n=1){
  state.discipline=state.discipline||{warning:0,minorDemerit:0};
  state.discipline.minorDemerit+=n;
}
function riskFaces(rule){
  const accumulated=Math.ceil(Math.max(0,rule.value(state)));
  return clamp((rule.baseFaces||1)+Math.max(0,accumulated-1),1,5);
}
function riskActive(rule){
  return !state.consequencesDone[rule.id] && rule.value(state)>0;
}
function riskSnapshot(){
  const o={};DICE_RULES.forEach(r=>o[r.id]=Math.max(0,r.value(state)));return o;
}
function markRaisedRisks(before){
  state.riskMeta=state.riskMeta||{};
  state.classId=state.classId||"";
  state.chapter1Review=state.chapter1Review||null;
  state.stats.confidence=state.stats.confidence??55;
  state.discipline=state.discipline||{warning:0,minorDemerit:0};
  state.pendingAftermaths=Array.isArray(state.pendingAftermaths)?state.pendingAftermaths:[];
  DICE_RULES.forEach(r=>{
    const now=Math.max(0,r.value(state)),old=before[r.id]||0;
    if(now>old){
      state.riskMeta[r.id]=state.riskMeta[r.id]||{};
      state.riskMeta[r.id].raisedDay=state.daySerial||0;
    }
  });
}
function eventContexts(ev){
  const c=[];
  if(!ev)return c;
  if(ev.speaker==="老師"||ev.sprite==="sp_teacher")c.push("teacher");
  if(ev.speaker==="媽媽"||ev.sprite==="sp_mom"||ev.bg==="bg_home")c.push("family");
  if(ev.speaker==="阿哲"||ev.sprite==="sp_azhe")c.push("azhe");
  if((ev.label||"").includes("群組"))c.push("group");
  if(ev.bg==="bg_classroom")c.push("school");
  return [...new Set(c)];
}
function findRiskForContext(contexts){
  if(!contexts||!contexts.length)return null;
  state.riskMeta=state.riskMeta||{};
  const candidates=DICE_RULES.filter(r=>{
    if(!riskActive(r)||state.week<(r.minWeek||1))return false;
    if(!r.contexts.some(c=>contexts.includes(c)))return false;
    const meta=state.riskMeta[r.id]||{};
    if((meta.raisedDay??-1)>=(state.daySerial||0))return false;
    if(meta.lastCheckWeek===state.week)return false;
    return true;
  });
  if(!candidates.length)return null;
  candidates.sort((a,b)=>riskFaces(b)-riskFaces(a));
  return candidates[0];
}
function decaySoftRisks(){
  ["memeRisk","jokeRisk","cheatRisk","answerRisk"].forEach(k=>{
    if((state.hidden[k]||0)>0)state.hidden[k]=Math.max(0,state.hidden[k]-1);
  });
}

function aftermathDue(item){
  if(!item)return false;
  if(typeof item==="string")return true;
  if((state.week||1)>(item.dueWeek||1))return true;
  if((state.week||1)<(item.dueWeek||1))return false;
  return (state.daySerial||0)>=(item.dueDay||0);
}

const CLASS_INDEX_KEY="our14_v12_class_index";
const ACTIVE_CLASS_KEY="our14_v12_active_class";
const CLASS_PREFIX="our14_v12_class_";
const MIGRATION_KEY="our14_v12_migrated_v11";

function newClassId(){
  if(globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID)return crypto.randomUUID().replace(/-/g,"").slice(0,18);
  return "c"+Date.now().toString(36)+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,9);
}
function getClassIndex(){
  try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CLASS_INDEX_KEY)||"[]");}catch(e){return [];}
}
function setClassIndex(list){localStorage.setItem(CLASS_INDEX_KEY,JSON.stringify(list));}
function classKey(id){return CLASS_PREFIX+id;}
function activeClassId(){return localStorage.getItem(ACTIVE_CLASS_KEY)||"";}
function setActiveClass(id){if(id)localStorage.setItem(ACTIVE_CLASS_KEY,id);else localStorage.removeItem(ACTIVE_CLASS_KEY);}
function escapeHtml(s=""){return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;"}[m]));}
function fmtTime(ts){
  if(!ts)return "尚未開始";
  try{return new Date(ts).toLocaleString("zh-TW",{month:"numeric",day:"numeric",hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"});}catch(e){return "";}
}
function upsertClassMeta(){
  if(!state.classId)return;
  const list=getClassIndex();
  const meta={
    id:state.classId,
    name:state.className||"未命名班級",
    updated:Date.now(),
    week:state.week||1,
    finished:!!state.finished,
    grade:state.chapter1Review?.grade||"",
    warnings:state.discipline?.warning||0,
    demerits:state.discipline?.minorDemerit||0
  };
  const i=list.findIndex(x=>x.id===state.classId);
  if(i>=0)list[i]=meta;else list.push(meta);
  list.sort((a,b)=>(b.updated||0)-(a.updated||0));
  setClassIndex(list);
}

const OUR14_CLOUD_URL="https://efqmwxrxnvuyhrllhowq.supabase.co/functions/v1/our14-cloud-save";
const CLOUD_HASH_PREFIX="#cloud=";
let cloudSaveTimer=null;

function cloudToast(msg){try{toast(msg)}catch(e){console.log(msg)}}
async function cloudRequest(payload){
  const r=await fetch(OUR14_CLOUD_URL,{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify(payload)});
  let data={}; try{data=await r.json()}catch(e){}
  if(!r.ok||!data.ok)throw new Error(data.error||`雲端連線失敗（${r.status}）`);
  return data;
}
function tokenFromUrl(input=location.href){
  try{
    const u=new URL(input,location.href);
    if(u.hash.startsWith(CLOUD_HASH_PREFIX))return u.hash.slice(CLOUD_HASH_PREFIX.length).trim();
    const q=u.searchParams.get("cloud");
    return (q||"").trim();
  }catch(e){return "";}
}
function currentCloudToken(){return (state&&state.cloudToken) || "";}
function cloudUrlFor(token){
  const u=new URL(location.href);
  u.searchParams.delete("cloud");
  u.hash=CLOUD_HASH_PREFIX+token;
  return u.toString();
}
function setCloudUrl(token,replace=true){
  if(!token)return;
  if(state)state.cloudToken=token;
  const u=cloudUrlFor(token);
  if(replace)history.replaceState(null,"",u);else history.pushState(null,"",u);
}
const TEACHER_TOKEN_KEY="our14_teacher_token_v1";
function validTeacherToken(token){return /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{32,160}$/.test(String(token||""));}
function teacherTokenFromUrl(input=location.href){
  try{return new URL(input,location.href).searchParams.get("teacher")||"";}catch(e){return "";}
}
function currentTeacherToken(){
  const fromUrl=teacherTokenFromUrl();
  if(validTeacherToken(fromUrl))return fromUrl;
  const local=localStorage.getItem(TEACHER_TOKEN_KEY)||"";
  return validTeacherToken(local)?local:"";
}
function teacherUrlFor(token){
  const u=new URL(location.href);
  u.searchParams.set("teacher",token);
  u.searchParams.delete("cloud");
  u.hash="";
  return u.toString();
}

function normalizeExternalState(s){
  s.stats=s.stats||{};
  s.stats.confidence=s.stats.confidence??55;
  s.discipline=s.discipline||{warning:0,minorDemerit:0};
  s.formalConsequences=s.formalConsequences||{fakeSignDemeritApplied:false};
  s.chapter1Review=s.chapter1Review||null;
  s.traitPoints=s.traitPoints||{stable:0,lastMinute:0,relationship:0,grind:0,anxious:0,face:0,avoid:0,rebound:0};
  s.activityFamiliarity=s.activityFamiliarity||{};
  s.chapter=s.chapter||1;
  s.chapterStart=s.chapterStart||{
    money:300,energy:80,fatigue:20,stress:20,
    stats:{study:45,social:40,family:55,mood:60,self:30,confidence:55},
    mastery:{chinese:58,english:60,math:48,science:55,social:57},
    relations:{qing:"還不熟",zhe:"還不熟",jiahao:"還不熟",mom:"日常互動"}
  };
  s.relationshipEventsSeen=s.relationshipEventsSeen||{};
  s.relationships=s.relationships||{};
  s.pendingAftermaths=Array.isArray(s.pendingAftermaths)?s.pendingAftermaths:[];
  s.pendingAftermaths=s.pendingAftermaths.map(x=>typeof x==="string"?{
    id:x,dueWeek:s.week||1,dueDay:(s.daySerial||0)+1,
    queuedWeek:s.week||1,queuedDay:s.daySerial||0
  }:x);
  s.history=s.history||{confidenceMin:s.stats.confidence??55};
}

function round1(n){return Math.round(n*10)/10;}
function learningAbsorption(){
  let r=100;
  if(state.fatigue>=90) r-=55; else if(state.fatigue>=80) r-=40; else if(state.fatigue>=65) r-=25; else if(state.fatigue>=50) r-=10;
  const mood=state.stats.mood;
  if(mood<20) r-=35; else if(mood<35) r-=22; else if(mood<50) r-=8;
  if(state.stress>=80) r-=15; else if(state.stress>=65) r-=8;
  if(state.stats.confidence<25)r-=10; else if(state.stats.confidence<40)r-=5;
  if(state.habit?.trait==="stable") r+=5;
  if(state.habit?.trait==="pileup") r-=8;
  if(state.sickTurns>0) r=Math.min(r,35);
  return clamp(Math.round(r),25,100);
}
function healthLabel(){
  if(state.sickTurns>0) return ["🤒 生病中：上課容易想睡、念書吸收率大幅下降","statusBad"];
  if(state.fatigue>=85) return ["🥴 過度疲勞：再硬撐，生病風險很高","statusBad"];
  if(state.stats.mood<=25) return ["🌧️ 心情非常低落：動力與吸收都下降，也可能身體不舒服","statusBad"];
  if(state.fatigue>=65 || state.stats.mood<40) return ["⚠️ 狀態不佳：需要安排休息","statusWarn"];
  return ["🙂 狀態穩定","statusGood"];
}

function addTraitPoint(k,v){
  if(!TRAIT_DEFS[k]||!v)return;
  state.traitPoints=state.traitPoints||{};
  state.traitPoints[k]=Math.max(0,round1((state.traitPoints[k]||0)+v));
  const score=state.traitPoints[k];
  const cg=TRAIT_DEFS[k].cg;
  if(score>=6 && cg) unlock(cg);
}
function traitScores(){
  const p=state.traitPoints||{};
  const h=state.hidden||{};
  const hist=state.history||{confidenceMin:state.stats.confidence};
  const prepSum=Object.values(state.prep||{}).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
  return {
    stable:(p.stable||0)+(h.selfControl||0)*.6+(state.habit?.stableStreak||0)*3+Math.max(0,70-state.fatigue)*.035,
    lastMinute:(p.lastMinute||0)+(state.week>=6?prepSum*.35:0)+(h.avoidance||0)*.25,
    relationship:(p.relationship||0)+Math.max(0,state.stats.social-40)*.08+(ensureRelation("qing").affinity+ensureRelation("zhe").affinity+ensureRelation("jiahao").affinity)*.55,
    grind:(p.grind||0)+(h.studyEffort||0)*.18+Math.max(0,state.fatigue-62)*.035,
    anxious:(p.anxious||0)+Math.max(0,state.stress-45)*.12+Math.max(0,48-state.stats.mood)*.08,
    face:(p.face||0)+Math.max(0,state.stats.self-35)*.055+(h.selfControl||0)*.3-(h.avoidance||0)*.12,
    avoid:(p.avoid||0)+(h.avoidance||0)*.75,
    rebound:(p.rebound||0)+Math.max(0,state.stats.confidence-(hist.confidenceMin??55))*.25
  };
}
function currentTraits(){
  const scores=traitScores();
  return Object.entries(scores).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).map(([key,score])=>({key,score,def:TRAIT_DEFS[key]}));
}
function trackTraitsFromEffect(e,before){
  const st=e.stats||{},hd=e.hidden||{};
  if((hd.selfControl||0)>0||(st.self||0)>1)addTraitPoint("stable",.7);
  if((st.social||0)>1||(hd.qingTrust||0)>0||(hd.zheTrust||0)>0||(hd.friendTrust||0)>0)addTraitPoint("relationship",.8);
  if((hd.avoidance||0)>0)addTraitPoint("avoid",1.0);
  if((e.stress||0)>2||(st.mood||0)<-2||(st.confidence||0)<-3)addTraitPoint("anxious",.7);
  if(e.mastery||(st.study||0)>1)addTraitPoint("grind",.45);
  const riskReduced=["fakeSign","hideScore","memeRisk","cheatRisk","answerRisk","jokeRisk","loanRisk"].some(k=>(hd[k]||0)<0);
  if(riskReduced||(st.self||0)>=3)addTraitPoint("face",.75);
  if((st.confidence||0)>0)addTraitPoint("rebound",.7);
  state.history=state.history||{confidenceMin:55};
  state.history.confidenceMin=Math.min(state.history.confidenceMin??55,state.stats.confidence);
}

function dynamicText(ev){
  if(ev.dynamic==="storeMoney") return `週五放學前，群組開始約週末出去。

六個人很快都說「+1」。阿哲直接傳：「你一定會來吧？」

你也想去。只是你看了一眼錢包：現在還有 ${state.money} 元，而這週還沒有結束。`;
  if(ev.dynamic==="grouping") return `「四個人一組，下週上台。」

教室立刻開始搬椅子。阿哲朝你招手：「我們這邊還差一個！」
家豪也還沒有組。${relationStage("qing").n>=1?"\n小晴抬頭看了你一眼，好像也在等你決定。":""}

分組看起來像在選朋友，但一週後還要一起把東西做完。`;
  if(ev.dynamic==="night"){let line="還有好多。"; if((state.hidden.mathPrep||0)>=5 && state.stress<55) line="還有一些沒看完，但你知道自己不是完全沒準備。"; else if(state.stress>=55) line="每翻一頁，都覺得還有另一頁更重要。"; else if((state.hidden.avoidance||0)>=5) line="你開始想到前幾天那些『明天再說』。"; return `${line}

時間：23:48。群組裡還有人傳「我社會還沒看完」。
明天早上，就是第一次段考。`; }
  return ev.text;
}

function setEventSceneMode(mode="off"){
  const layout=document.getElementById("gameLayout");
  const dialogue=document.getElementById("dialogue");
  const intro=document.getElementById("eventIntroOverlay");
  const data=document.getElementById("eventDataBar");
  const topbar=document.querySelector("#game .topbar");

  layout?.classList.remove("eventSceneMode","riskSceneMode");
  dialogue?.classList.remove("eventDialogueMode","riskDialogueMode");
  intro?.classList.remove("show");
  data?.classList.remove("show");
  topbar?.classList.remove("cinematicHidden");

  if(mode==="intro"){
    layout?.classList.add("eventSceneMode");
    dialogue?.classList.add("cinematicHidden");
    intro?.classList.add("show");
    data?.classList.add("show");
    topbar?.classList.remove("cinematicHidden");
  }else if(mode==="play"){
    layout?.classList.add("eventSceneMode");
    dialogue?.classList.remove("cinematicHidden");
    dialogue?.classList.add("eventDialogueMode");
    data?.classList.add("show");
  }else if(mode==="risk"){
    layout?.classList.add("riskSceneMode");
    dialogue?.classList.remove("cinematicHidden");
    dialogue?.classList.add("riskDialogueMode");
    data?.classList.add("show");
  }else{
    dialogue?.classList.remove("cinematicHidden");
  }
}
function eventKindLabel(ev){
  if(ev?.cinematic)return "CG MOMENT｜關鍵場景";
  if(ev?.isAftermath)return "AFTERMATH｜後續影響";
  if(ev?.isConsequence)return "CONSEQUENCE｜後果事件";
  if(ev?.isHealth)return "HEALTH｜健康事件";
  if(ev?.relationMoment||ev?.relationMoments||ev?.crisisCg)return "RELATION｜關係事件";
  if(ev?.isExtra)return "DAILY｜生活事件";
  return "STORY｜主線事件";
}
function relevantEventPerson(ev){
  const map={"小晴":"qing","阿哲":"zhe","家豪":"jiahao","媽媽":"mom","家人":"mom"};
  if(map[ev?.speaker])return map[ev.speaker];
  const impacts=(ev?.choices||[]).flatMap(c=>Object.keys(c.relationImpact||{}));
  return impacts.length?impacts[0]:null;
}
function renderEventDataBar(){
  const el=document.getElementById("eventDataBar");if(!el)return;
  const subjectChips=Object.entries(state.mastery).map(([k,v])=>
    `<span class="eventDataChip">${SUBJECT_NAMES[k]} <b>${round1(v)}</b></span>`
  ).join("");
  const life=[
    ["💰",moneyLabel()],
    ["⚡",Math.round(state.energy)],
    ["🥱",Math.round(state.fatigue)],
    ["😵",Math.round(state.stress)],
    ["❤️",Math.round(state.stats.mood)],
    ["💪",Math.round(state.stats.confidence)]
  ].map(([n,v])=>`<span class="eventDataChip">${n} <b>${v}</b></span>`).join("");
  const p=relevantEventPerson(activeEvent);
  const rel=p?`<span class="eventDataChip relation">🤝 ${REL_NAMES[p]} <b>${relationStage(p).name}</b></span>`:"";
  const discipline=(state.discipline?.warning||0)+(state.discipline?.minorDemerit||0)>0
    ?`<span class="eventDataChip">📋 <b>警告 ${state.discipline?.warning||0}／小過 ${state.discipline?.minorDemerit||0}</b></span>`:"";
  el.innerHTML=
    `<div class="eventDataGroup subjects">${subjectChips}</div>`+
    `<div class="eventDataGroup status">${life}${rel}${discipline}</div>`;
}
function showEventIntro(){
  renderEventDataBar();
  setEventSceneMode("intro");
  const kind=document.getElementById("eventIntroKind");
  const title=document.getElementById("eventIntroTitle");
  const isMain=activeEvent&&Number.isFinite(activeEvent.week)&&!activeEvent.isExtra&&!activeEvent.isAftermath&&!activeEvent.isHealth&&!activeEvent.isConsequence;
  if(kind)kind.textContent=isMain?`WEEK ${activeEvent.week}｜${WEEK_LABELS[activeEvent.week]||"主線故事"}`:eventKindLabel(activeEvent);
  if(title)title.textContent=activeEvent?.label||"事件";
}
function enterCurrentEvent(){
  if(!activeEvent)return;
  setEventSceneMode("play");
  renderEventDataBar();
  document.getElementById("eventDataBar")?.classList.add("show");
  document.querySelector("#game .topbar")?.classList.remove("cinematicHidden");
  document.getElementById('speaker').textContent=activeEvent.speaker||"旁白";
  document.getElementById('hint').textContent=
    activeEvent.isAftermath?"這是前面選擇留下的後續影響。":
    activeEvent.isHealth?"健康狀況會影響後續生活與學習。":
    activeEvent.isConsequence?"這是前面的風險真正變成後果。":
    activeEvent.isExtra?"這是目前生活狀態帶出的事件。":
    "看完情境後，全班一起決定。";
  document.getElementById('widget').innerHTML="";
  document.getElementById('choices').innerHTML="";
  typewrite(dynamicText(activeEvent),()=>renderChoices(activeEvent));
}

function buildChoiceChangeSummary(before,relationChanges=[],riskBefore=null,choice=null){
  const now=visibleChoiceSnapshot();
  const defs=[
    ["money","💰 金錢"],["energy","⚡ 體力"],["fatigue","🥱 疲勞"],["stress","😵 壓力"],
    ["mood","❤️ 心情"],["confidence","💪 信心"],["study","📝 學習習慣"],
    ["social","💬 人際"],["family","🏠 家庭"],["self","🌱 自我"],
    ["chinese","國文"],["english","英文"],["math","數學"],["science","自然"],["socialM","社會"],
    ["warning","📋 警告"],["minorDemerit","📋 小過"]
  ];
  const chips=[];
  defs.forEach(([k,label])=>{
    const d=round1(now[k]-before[k]);
    if(Math.abs(d)>=.1){
      const badHigh=["fatigue","stress","warning","minorDemerit"].includes(k);
      const cls=(badHigh?(d>0?"down":"up"):(d>0?"up":"down"));
      chips.push(`<span class="changeChip ${cls}">${label} ${changeNum(d)}</span>`);
    }
  });
  relationChanges.filter(x=>Math.abs(x.delta)>=.05).forEach(x=>{
    chips.push(`<span class="changeChip ${x.delta>0?"up":"down"}">🤝 ${REL_NAMES[x.person]} ${x.delta>0?"靠近":"距離"} ${changeNum(x.delta)}</span>`);
  });
  if(riskBefore){
    const after=riskSnapshot();
    const raised=Object.keys(after).some(k=>(after[k]||0)>(riskBefore[k]||0));
    if(raised)chips.push(`<span class="changeChip warn">⚠️ 留下後續風險</span>`);
  }
  if(choice?.aftermath)chips.push(`<span class="changeChip warn">↪ 後續會在之後出現</span>`);
  if(!chips.length)chips.push(`<span class="changeChip neutral">這次沒有立即可見的數值變化，影響可能在後續才出現。</span>`);
  return `<div class="changeSummary">${chips.slice(0,10).join("")}</div>`;
}
function setVisual(ev){
  document.getElementById('visual').style.backgroundImage=`url("${A[ev.bg||'bg_classroom']}")`;
  const tag=document.getElementById('tag');
  tag.textContent=ev.label;
  tag.className='tag'+(ev.isHealth?' consequence':ev.isConsequence?' consequence':ev.isExtra?' random':'');
  if(ev.sprite){document.getElementById('spriteImg').src=A[ev.sprite]; document.getElementById('spriteWrap').style.display='block';} else document.getElementById('spriteWrap').style.display='none';
  if(ev.unlock) unlock(ev.unlock);
}
function renderWidget(ev){
  const box=document.getElementById('widget'); box.innerHTML="";
  if(ev.widget==="examScope"){
    const rows=[["國文",7],["英文",5],["數學",9],["自然",6],["社會",8]];
    box.innerHTML=`<div class="scopeBox"><div class="scopeCap">長條代表這次段考各科要準備的內容多寡／負擔，越長表示範圍越多，不是分數。</div>${rows.map(([n,v])=>`<div class="scopeRow"><div>${n}</div><div class="scopeBar"><div class="scopeFill" style="width:${v*10}%"></div></div><div>${v}/10</div></div>`).join('')}</div>`;
  }
}

  renderWidget(ev);

    }
  });
  relationChanges.filter(x=>Math.abs(x.delta)>=.05).forEach(x=>{

  });

    if(raised)chips.push(`<span class="changeChip warn">⚠️ 留下後續風險</span>`);
  }
  if(choice?.aftermath)chips.push(`<span class="changeChip warn">↪ 後續會在之後出現</span>`);
  if(!chips.length)chips.push(`<span class="changeChip neutral">這次沒有立即可見的數值變化，影響可能在後續才出現。</span>`);
  return `<div class="changeSummary">${chips.slice(0,10).join("")}</div>`;
}
function setVisual(ev){
  document.getElementById('visual').style.backgroundImage=`url("${A[ev.bg||'bg_classroom']}")`;
  const tag=document.getElementById('tag');
  tag.textContent=ev.label;
  tag.className='tag'+(ev.isHealth?' consequence':ev.isConsequence?' consequence':ev.isExtra?' random':'');
  if(ev.sprite){document.getElementById('spriteImg').src=A[ev.sprite]; document.getElementById('spriteWrap').style.display='block';} else document.getElementById('spriteWrap').style.display='none';
  if(ev.unlock) unlock(ev.unlock);
}
function renderWidget(ev){
  const box=document.getElementById('widget'); box.innerHTML="";
  if(ev.widget==="examScope"){
    const rows=[["國文",7],["英文",5],["數學",9],["自然",6],["社會",8]];
    box.innerHTML=`<div class="scopeBox"><div class="scopeCap">長條代表這次段考各科要準備的內容多寡／負擔，越長表示範圍越多，不是分數。</div>${rows.map(([n,v])=>`<div class="scopeRow"><div>${n}</div><div class="scopeBar"><div class="scopeFill" style="width:${v*10}%"></div></div><div>${v}/10</div></div>`).join('')}</div>`;
  }
}
function renderChoices(ev){
  renderWidget(ev);
  const remaining=Math.max(0,(state.basicDaysPerWeek||7)-(state.basicDaysPaid||0));
  const futureBasic=remaining*(state.dailyBasicCost||35);
  document.getElementById('choices').innerHTML=ev.choices.map((c,i)=>{
    const spend=Math.max(0,-(c.effect?.money||0));
    const insufficient=spend>0&&state.money<spend;
    const eatsBasics=spend>0&&!insufficient&&(state.money-spend)<futureBasic;
    let note=c.cost||"";
    if(insufficient)note=`💰 錢不夠（需要 ${spend} 元，目前 ${Math.round(state.money)} 元）`;
    else if(eatsBasics)note=`${note}${note?"｜":""}⚠️ 付得起，但會吃到後面基本生活費`;
    return `<button class="choice" ${insufficient?'disabled style="opacity:.48;cursor:not-allowed"':''} onclick="${insufficient?'':`chooseOption(${i})`}"><div><span class="letter">${c.letter}</span>${c.text}<span class="cost">${note}</span></div><span class="adopt">${insufficient?'無法選':'採用 '+c.letter}</span></button>`;
  }).join('');
}
let activeEventAbsorb=100;

function showEvent(ev=null){
  setChapterCGIntroMode(false);
  setEventSceneMode("off");
  document.getElementById('dialogue')?.classList.remove('chapterReviewMode');
  document.getElementById('gameLayout')?.classList.remove('chapterOverlayMode');
  renderSide();
  if(state.finished)return showExam();
  activeEvent=ev||currentEvent();
  if(!activeEvent)return finishWeek();
  activeEventAbsorb=learningAbsorption();
  document.getElementById('speaker').textContent="";
  document.getElementById('story').textContent="";
  document.getElementById('hint').textContent="";
  document.getElementById('widget').innerHTML="";
  document.getElementById('choices').innerHTML="";
  setVisual(activeEvent);
  showEventIntro();
  saveLocal(false);
}
function isSchoolEvent(ev){
  return ev&&!ev.isHealth&&!ev.isConsequence&&(ev.bg==="bg_classroom"||ev.speaker==="老師");
}
function riskBeforeChoice(){return riskSnapshot();}
function completeDayForEvent(ev){
  if(ev.isConsequence)return;
  state.daySerial=(state.daySerial||0)+1;
  chargeDailyBasicExpense();
  if(isSchoolEvent(ev)){
    state.weekAbsorbSamples=state.weekAbsorbSamples||[];
    state.weekAbsorbSamples.push(activeEventAbsorb);
  }
  if(state.scheduleDone&&!ev.isHealth)executeNextPlanUnit();
}

  if(activeEvent?.isConsequence&&((c.effect?.stats?.self||0)>=3))unlock("cg_trait_face");
  addLog(c.log||"做了一個選擇");

  if(activeEvent.isConsequence){
    state.pendingConsequenceId=null;
    if(c.aftermath)queueAftermath(c.aftermath);
  }else if(activeEvent.isAftermath){

function showEvent(ev=null){
  setChapterCGIntroMode(false);
  setEventSceneMode("off");
  document.getElementById('dialogue')?.classList.remove('chapterReviewMode');
  document.getElementById('gameLayout')?.classList.remove('chapterOverlayMode');
  renderSide();
  if(state.finished)return showExam();
  activeEvent=ev||currentEvent();
  if(!activeEvent)return finishWeek();
  activeEventAbsorb=learningAbsorption();
  document.getElementById('speaker').textContent="";

function isSchoolEvent(ev){
  return ev&&!ev.isHealth&&!ev.isConsequence&&(ev.bg==="bg_classroom"||ev.speaker==="老師");
}
function riskBeforeChoice(){return riskSnapshot();}
function completeDayForEvent(ev){
  if(ev.isConsequence)return;
  state.daySerial=(state.daySerial||0)+1;
  chargeDailyBasicExpense();
  if(isSchoolEvent(ev)){
    state.weekAbsorbSamples=state.weekAbsorbSamples||[];
    state.weekAbsorbSamples.push(activeEventAbsorb);
  }
  if(state.scheduleDone&&!ev.isHealth)executeNextPlanUnit();
}
function chooseOption(i){
  const c=activeEvent.choices[i];
  const before=riskBeforeChoice();
  const beforeVisible=visibleChoiceSnapshot();
  const beforeRel=relationSnapshot();
  applyEffect(c.effect||{});
  const relationChanges=processRelationshipChoice(activeEvent,c);
  notifyRelationshipChanges(beforeRel,relationChanges);
  const visibleSummary=buildChoiceChangeSummary(beforeVisible,relationChanges,before,c);
  if(activeEvent?.isConsequence&&((c.effect?.stats?.self||0)>=3))unlock("cg_trait_face");
  addLog(c.log||"做了一個選擇");

  if(activeEvent.isConsequence){
    state.pendingConsequenceId=null;
    if(c.aftermath)queueAftermath(c.aftermath);
  }else if(activeEvent.isAftermath){
    // 後續影響事件只負責演出，不額外推進主線格數。
  }else if(activeEvent.isHealth){
    state.pendingHealthEvent=false;
  }else if(activeEvent.isExtra){
    state.extraSeen=(state.extraSeen||0)+1;
    if(activeEvent.unique){
      state.relationshipEventsSeen=state.relationshipEventsSeen||{};
      state.relationshipEventsSeen[activeEvent.id]=true;
    }
    if(state.pendingExtraId&&!state.usedExtras.includes(state.pendingExtraId))state.usedExtras.push(state.pendingExtraId);
    state.pendingExtraId=null;
  }else{
    state.idx+=1;
  }

  if(!activeEvent.isAftermath)completeDayForEvent(activeEvent);
  markRaisedRisks(before);

  if(!activeEvent.isConsequence&&!activeEvent.isHealth&&!activeEvent.isAftermath){
    state.pendingRiskContext=eventContexts(activeEvent);
  }

  if(!activeEvent.isHealth&&!activeEvent.isAftermath&&state.sickTurns>0){
    state.sickTurns=Math.max(0,state.sickTurns-1);
    if(state.sickTurns===0)state.healthCooldown=2;
  }else if(state.healthCooldown>0&&!activeEvent.isHealth&&!activeEvent.isAftermath){
    state.healthCooldown=Math.max(0,state.healthCooldown-1);
  }
  checkHealthRisk();

  renderSide();
  renderEventDataBar();
  document.getElementById('speaker').textContent=activeEvent.isAftermath?"後續影響":"結果";
  document.getElementById('hint').textContent=activeEvent.isAftermath?"後果不會立刻消失，這些影響會繼續留在生活裡。":activeEvent.isHealth?"身體狀態會繼續影響後面的安排。":activeEvent.isConsequence?"處理當下只是第一步，後續影響仍可能繼續。":"下面先顯示這次選擇的立即變化；有些影響會延後才出現。";
  document.getElementById('widget').innerHTML=visibleSummary;
  document.getElementById('choices').innerHTML="";
  typewrite(c.result,()=>{document.getElementById('choices').innerHTML=`<div class="resultBtns"><button class="stopBtn" onclick="stopToday()">今天先玩到這裡</button><button class="nextBtn" onclick="continueAfterChoice()">如果還有時間，繼續</button></div>`;});
  saveLocal(false);
}
function showDicePrompt(){
  const pd=state.pendingDice;if(!pd)return resumeFlow();
  const rule=DICE_RULES.find(r=>r.id===pd.ruleId);if(!rule){state.pendingDice=null;return resumeFlow();}
  activeEvent={label:`🎲 風險判定｜${rule.name}`,speaker:"風險骰",bg:pd.bg||"bg_classroom",isDice:true};
  setVisual(activeEvent);
  setEventSceneMode("risk");
  renderEventDataBar();

  document.getElementById('speaker').textContent="🎲 風險判定";
  document.getElementById('hint').textContent="危險面越多，代表前面的選擇越容易在這次相關情境中變成後果。";
  document.getElementById('subjectStrip').innerHTML="";
  document.getElementById('widget').innerHTML=`<div class="riskFaces">${[1,2,3,4,5,6].map(n=>`<span class="riskFace ${n<=pd.faces?'hot':''}">${n}</span>`).join("")}</div>`;
  document.getElementById('choices').innerHTML="";
  typewrite(`前面的選擇留下了「${rule.name}」風險。\n目前危險面：${pd.faces} / 6。\n這次剛好遇到相關情境。`,()=>{
    document.getElementById('choices').innerHTML=`<button class="choice" onclick="rollRiskDice()"><div><span class="letter">🎲</span>擲骰子<span class="cost">1～${pd.faces}：出現後果；${pd.faces+1}～6：這次沒事</span></div><span class="adopt">擲骰</span></button>`;
  });
  saveLocal(false);
}

  state.pendingDice={ruleId:rule.id,faces:riskFaces(rule),bg:ru

function showDicePrompt(){
  const pd=state.pendingDice;if(!pd)return resumeFlow();
  const rule=DICE_RULES.find(r=>r.id===pd.ruleId);if(!rule){state.pendingDice=null;return resumeFlow();}
  activeEvent={label:`🎲 風險判定｜${rule.name}`,speaker:"風險骰",bg:pd.bg||"bg_classroom",isDice:true};
  setVisual(activeEvent);
  setEventSceneMode("risk");
  renderEventDataBar();

  document.getElementById('speaker').textContent="🎲 風險判定";
  document.getElementById('hint').textContent="危險面越多，代表前面的選擇越容易在這次相關情境中變成後果。";
  document.getElementById('subjectStrip').innerHTML="";
  document.getElementById('widget').innerHTML=`<div class="riskFaces">${[1,2,3,4,5,6].map(n=>`<span class="riskFace ${n<=pd.faces?'hot':''}">${n}</span>`).join("")}</div>`;
  document.getElementById('choices').innerHTML="";
  typewrite(`前面的選擇留下了「${rule.name}」風險。\n目前危險面：${pd.faces} / 6。\n這次剛好遇到相關情境。`,()=>{
    document.getElementById('choices').innerHTML=`<button class="choice" onclick="rollRiskDice()"><div><span class="letter">🎲</span>擲骰子<span class="cost">1～${pd.faces}：出現後果；${pd.faces+1}～6：這次沒事</span></div><span class="adopt">擲骰</span></button>`;
  });
  saveLocal(false);
}
function beginDice(rule){
  state.pendingDice={ruleId:rule.id,faces:riskFaces(rule),bg:rule.contexts.includes("family")?"bg_home":"bg_classroom"};
  state.pendingRiskContext=null;
  showDicePrompt();
  return true;
}
function rollRiskDice(){
  const pd=state.pendingDice;if(!pd)return;
  const rule=DICE_RULES.find(r=>r.id===pd.ruleId);if(!rule)return;
  const roll=1+Math.floor(Math.random()*6);
  const hit=roll<=pd.faces;
  state.riskMeta=state.riskMeta||{};
  state.riskMeta[rule.id]=state.riskMeta[rule.id]||{};
  state.riskMeta[rule.id].lastCheckWeek=state.week;
  setEventSceneMode("risk");
  renderEventDataBar();
  document.getElementById('widget').innerHTML=`<div class="diceBig">🎲 ${roll}</div>`;
  document.getElementById('speaker').textContent=hit?"骰中了":"這次沒有骰中";
  if(hit){
    state.consequencesDone[rule.id]=true;
    state.pendingConsequenceId=rule.id;
    state.pendingDice=null;
    document.getElementById('story').textContent=`骰到 ${roll}。目前危險面是 1～${pd.faces}。\n\n這次，前面的風險真的變成了後果。`;
    document.getElementById('choices').innerHTML=`<div class="resultBtns"><button class="stopBtn" onclick="stopToday()">今天先到這裡</button><button class="nextBtn" onclick="showPendingConsequence()">面對後果</button></div>`;
  }else{
    if(rule.safeEffect)applyEffect(rule.safeEffect);
    if(rule.resolveOnSafe)state.consequencesDone[rule.id]=true;
    state.pendingDice=null;
    document.getElementById('story').textContent=`骰到 ${roll}。目前危險面是 1～${pd.faces}。\n\n${rule.safeText||"這一次沒有出事。但如果風險本身沒有被處理，未來遇到相關情境仍可能再判定。"}`;
    document.getElementById('choices').innerHTML=`<div class="resultBtns"><button class="stopBtn" onclick="stopToday()">今天先到這裡</button><button class="nextBtn" onclick="resumeFlow()">繼續</button></div>`;
  }
  renderSide();saveLocal(false);
}

function rollRiskDice(){
  const pd=state.pendingDice;if(!pd)return;
  const rule=DICE_RULES.find(r=>r.id===pd.ruleId);if(!rule)return;
  const roll=1+Math.floor(Math.random()*6);
  const hit=roll<=pd.faces;
  state.riskMeta=state.riskMeta||{};

    if(rule.resolveOnSafe)state.consequencesDone[rule.id]=true;

function showPendingConsequence(){
  if(!state.pendingConsequenceId)return resumeFlow();
  const rule=DICE_RULES.find(r=>r.id===state.pendingConsequenceId);
  if(!rule){state.pendingConsequenceId=null;return resumeFlow();}
  if(rule.id==="fakeSign"){
    state.formalConsequences=state.formalConsequences||{fakeSignDemeritApplied:false};
    if(!state.formalConsequences.fakeSignDemeritApplied){
      addMinorDemerit(1);
      state.formalConsequences.fakeSignDemeritApplied=true;
      state.stats.confidence=clamp(state.stats.confidence-4);
      state.stats.mood=clamp(state.stats.mood-3);
      state.stress=clamp(state.stress+5);
      addLog("偷簽家長簽名被確認：通知導師與家長，記小過1次。");
      toast("📋 校規處理：小過 1 次");
      saveLocal(false);
    }
  }
  showEvent(rule.consequence());
}

  }
  finishWeek();
}

function showDicePrompt(){
  const pd=state.pendingDice;if(!pd)return resumeFlow();
  const rule=DICE_RULES.find(r=>r.id===pd.ruleId);if(!rule){state.pendingDice=null;return resumeFlow();}
  activeEvent={label:`🎲 風險判定｜${rule.name}`,speaker:"風險骰",bg:pd.bg||"bg_classroom",isDice:true};
  setVisual(activeEvent);
  setEventSceneMode("risk");
  renderEventDataBar();

  document.getElementById('speaker').textContent="🎲 風險判定";
  document.getElementById('hint').textContent="危險面越多，代表前面的選擇越容易在這次相關情境中變成後果。";
  document.getElementById('subjectStrip').innerHTML="";
  document.getElementById('widget').innerHTML=`<div class="riskFaces">${[1,2,3,4,5,6].map(n=>`<span class="riskFace ${n<=pd.faces?'hot':''}">${n}</span>`).join("")}</div>`;
  document.getElementById('choices').innerHTML="";
  typewrite(`前面的選擇留下了「${rule.name}」風險。\n目前危險面：${pd.faces} / 6。\n這次剛好遇到相關情境。`,()=>{
    document.getElementById('choices').innerHTML=`<button class="choice" onclick="rollRiskDice()"><div><span class="letter">🎲</span>擲骰子<span class="cost">1～${pd.faces}：出現後果；${pd.faces+1}～6：這次沒事</span></div><span class="adopt">擲骰</span></button>`;
  });
  saveLocal(false);
}
function beginDice(rule){
  state.pendingDice={ruleId:rule.id,faces:riskFaces(rule),bg:rule.contexts.includes("family")?"bg_home":"bg_classroom"};
  state.pendingRiskContext=null;
  showDicePrompt();
  return true;
}
function rollRiskDice(){
  const pd=state.pendingDice;if(!pd)return;
  const rule=DICE_RULES.find(r=>r.id===pd.ruleId);if(!rule)return;
  const roll=1+Math.floor(Math.random()*6);
  const hit=roll<=pd.faces;
  state.riskMeta=state.riskMeta||{};
  state.riskMeta[rule.id]=state.riskMeta[rule.id]||{};
  state.riskMeta[rule.id].lastCheckWeek=state.week;
  setEventSceneMode("risk");
  renderEventDataBar();
  document.getElementById('widget').innerHTML=`<div class="diceBig">🎲 ${roll}</div>`;
  document.getElementById('speaker').textContent=hit?"骰中了":"這次沒有骰中";
  if(hit){
    state.consequencesDone[rule.id]=true;
    state.pendingConsequenceId=rule.id;
    state.pendingDice=null;
    document.getElementById('story').textContent=`骰到 ${roll}。目前危險面是 1～${pd.faces}。\n\n這次，前面的風險真的變成了後果。`;
    document.getElementById('choices').innerHTML=`<div class="resultBtns"><button class="stopBtn" onclick="stopToday()">今天先到這裡</button><button class="nextBtn" onclick="showPendingConsequence()">面對後果</button></div>`;
  }else{
    if(rule.safeEffect)applyEffect(rule.safeEffect);
    if(rule.resolveOnSafe)state.consequencesDone[rule.id]=true;
    state.pendingDice=null;
    document.getElementById('story').textContent=`骰到 ${roll}。目前危險面是 1～${pd.faces}。\n\n${rule.safeText||"這一次沒有出事。但如果風險本身沒有被處理，未來遇到相關情境仍可能再判定。"}`;
    document.getElementById('choices').innerHTML=`<div class="resultBtns"><button class="stopBtn" onclick="stopToday()">今天先到這裡</button><button class="nextBtn" onclick="resumeFlow()">繼續</button></div>`;
  }
  renderSide();saveLocal(false);
}

  ensureWeekSetup();

  const due=Math.min(state.idx,Math.min(3,target));
  if((state.extraSeen||0)<due){
    const ex=nextExtraEvent();if(ex){showEvent(ex);return;}

  if(state.idx<3){showEvent();return;}

function resumeFlow(){
  if(state.pendingDice){showDicePrompt();return;}
  if(state.pendingConsequenceId){showPendingConsequence();return;}
  if(hasDueAftermath()){showQueuedAftermath();return;}
  // 每週第一個主線事件後，先安排本週接下來的生活。
  if(state.idx>=1&&!state.scheduleDone){openSchedule();return;}
  if(state.pendingHealthEvent){showEvent(makeHealthEvent());return;}
  if(state.pendingRiskContext&&maybeStartDice())return;
  continueNormalFlow();
}

function activityPreview(a){
  if(a.kind==="studyOne"||a.kind==="studyPair"){
    const absorb=learningAbsorption()/100;
    const gains=a.subjects.map(sub=>round1(a.baseGain*absorb*masteryDifficulty(sub)));
    const names=a.subjects.map(s=>SUBJECT_NAMES[s]).join("＋");
    const gainText=a.subjects.length===1?`約 +${gains[0]}`:`約各 +${gains.join("／+")}`;

  }
  if(a.id==="library")return `⏱ 2格｜集中補目前最弱科｜疲勞較低｜${familiarityName(a.id)}`;
  if(a.id==="qing_review")return `⏱ 2格｜一起訂正弱科／關係也會慢慢累積｜${familiarityName(a.id)}`;

  if(a.id==="club")return `⏱ 1格｜自我、心情、信心｜${familiarityName(a.id)}`;
  return `⏱ ${a.time}格｜${a.desc}｜${familiarityName(a.id)}`;
}
function renderSchedule(){
  const [hl,hc]=healthLabel();
  const used=timeUsed(),remain=WEEK_TIME_BUDGET-used;
  const future=Math.max(0,((state.basicDaysPerWeek||7)-(state.basicDaysPaid||0))*(state.dailyBasicCost||35));
  const wish=ensureWeeklyWish();
  document.getElementById('scheduleHealthHint').innerHTML=`目前：<b class="${hc}">${hl}</b><br>吸收率 <b>${learningAbsorption()}%</b>。熟練度越高越難提升；同一活動做久了也會逐漸熟悉。<div class="wishBox">💭 <b>主角這週的心聲</b><br>${wish.text}<br><span style="color:#9da9bb">可以不照做，但長期完全忽略自己的需求，心情與自我感受也會受影響。</span></div>`;
  document.getElementById('timeBudget').innerHTML=`本週自由時間：<b>${WEEK_TIME_BUDGET} 格</b>　已用 <b>${used}</b>　剩餘 <b>${remain}</b><br>目前現金 ${moneyLabel()}；本週後面仍約有 <b>${future} 元</b>基本生活費。`;
  document.getElementById('pickedList').innerHTML=schedulePick.length?schedulePick.map((id,i)=>{
    const a=activities.find(x=>x.id===id);
    return `<div class="pickedItem"><span>${i+1}. ${a.name}　<small style="color:#aeb8c9">(${a.time}格)</small></span><button class="ghost" style="padding:5px 8px" onclick="removeActivity(${i})">移除</button></div>`;
  }).join(''):`<div style="color:#7e899c;font-size:12px">尚未安排。請把 6 格時間分配完。</div>`;
  const study=activities.filter(a=>a.kind==="studyOne"||a.kind==="studyPair"||a.kind==="specialStudy");
  const life=activities.filter(a=>a.kind==="life"||a.kind==="specialLife");
  const btn=a=>{
    const ok=activityUnlocked(a),tier=studyTier(a);
    return `<button class="activity ${a.kind} ${ok?"":"lockedAct"}" ${ok?`onclick="addActivity('${a.id}')"`:"disabled"}><strong>${a.name}${tier?`<span class="tierTag">${tier}</span>`:""}</strong><span>${activityPreview(a)}${ok?"":`<span class="unlockReason">🔒 ${activityUnlockReason(a)}</span>`}</span></button>`;
  };
  document.getElementById('activities').innerHTML=`<div style="grid-column:1/-1;font-weight:900;color:#9fe0b3;margin-top:4px">📚 學習／解鎖課程</div>`+
    study.map(btn).join('')+
    `<div style="grid-column:1/-1;font-weight:900;color:#f2d783;margin-top:10px">🌿 生活／關係／恢復</div>`+
    life.map(btn).join('');
}
function addActivity(id){
  const a=activities.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!a)return;
  if(!activityUnlocked(a))return toast("這個行程還沒有解鎖");
  if(timeUsed()+a.time>WEEK_TIME_BUDGET)return toast("這週剩下的時間不夠安排這個活動");
  schedulePick.push(id);renderSchedule();
}

===== #24 AFTERMATH @ 1619937 =====

  return 1;

function averageWeekAbsorption(){
  const arr=state.weekAbsorbSamples||[];
  if(!arr.length)return learningAbsorption();
  return arr.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/arr.length;
}
function applyWeeklyClassLearning(){
  const avg=averageWeekAbsorption()/100;
  const msgs=[];
  Object.keys(state.mastery).forEach(k=>{
    let gain=.78*avg*classFoundationFactor(state.mastery[k]);
    if(state.habit?.trait==="stable")gain*=1.06;
    if(state.habit?.trait==="pileup")gain*=.90;
    gain=round1(gain);
    state.mastery[k]=clamp(round1(state.mastery[k]+gain));
    msgs.push(`${SUBJECT_NAMES[k]}+${gain}`);
  });
  addLog(`本週平日上課平均吸收率 ${Math.round(avg*100)}%：${msgs.join("、")}`);
}
function decayPrep(){
  Object.keys(state.prep).forEach(k=>state.prep[k]=round1(state.prep[k]*.55));
}
function finishRemainingDays(){
  while((state.basicDaysPaid||0)<(state.basicDaysPerWeek||7)){
    chargeDailyBasicExpense();
    if(state.planCursor<state.planUnits.length)executeNextPlanUnit();
  }
  if(state.planCursor<state.planUnits.length){
    const missed=state.planUnits.length-state.planCursor;
    addLog(`本週因時間／健康狀況，有 ${missed} 格原訂行程沒有完成。`);
  }
}
function confirmSchedule(){
  if(timeUsed()!==WEEK_TIME_BUDGET)return toast(`還有 ${WEEK_TIME_BUDGET-timeUsed()} 格時間沒有安排`);
  state.weekPlan=[...schedulePick];
  if(wishSatisfied(schedulePick)){
    state.stats.mood=clamp(state.stats.mood+1);state.stats.self=clamp(state.stats.self+1);state.ignoredWishStreak=0;
    addLog("本週安排有回應到主角自己的需要。");
  }else{
    state.ignoredWishStreak=(state.ignoredWishStreak||0)+1;
    if(state.ignoredWishStreak>=2){state.stats.mood=clamp(state.stats.mood-1);state.stats.self=clamp(state.stats.self-1);addLog("連續幾週都沒有顧到自己的需要，心情有點被擠到後面。");}
  }
  state.planUnits=buildPlanUnits(schedulePick);
  state.planCursor=0;state.executedUnits=[];state.scheduleDone=true;
  addLog("本週計畫："+schedulePick.map(id=>activities.find(a=>a.id===id).name.replace(/[^\u4e00-\u9fff＋]/g,"")).join("、"));
  closeOverlay('scheduleOverlay');
  saveLocal(false);
  resumeFlow();
}
function finishWeek(){
  if(state.finished)return showExam();
  if(state.week>=7 && Array.isArray(state.pendingAftermaths) && state.pendingAftermaths.length){
    showQueuedAftermath(true);
    return;
  }
  finishRemainingDays();
  applyWeeklyClassLearning();
  updateHabit();
  checkHealthRisk();
  if(state.week>=7){
    state.finished=true;unlock('bg_gate');saveLocal(false);showExam();return;
  }
  decayPrep();
  decaySoftRisks();
  state.week+=1;state.idx=0;
  state.extraTarget=0;state.extraSeen=0;state.usedExtras=[];state.pendingExtraId=null;
  state.scheduleDone=false;state.weekPlan=[];state.planUnits=[];state.planCursor=0;state.executedUnits=[];
  state.weekAbsorbSamples=[];state.weekAvoidanceStart=state.hidden.avoidance||0;state.weeklyWish=null;
  state.basicDaysPaid=0;
  state.pendingRiskContext=null;
  state.money+=300;
  if((state.hidden.familyAdvance||0)>0){
    const repay=Math.min(state.hidden.familyAdvance,state.money);
    state.money-=repay;state.hidden.familyAdvance-=repay;
    addLog(`新一週先償還家人預支 ${repay} 元。`);
  }
  if((state.hidden.loanFromFriend||0)>0&&state.money>=state.hidden.loanFromFriend){
    const repay=state.hidden.loanFromFriend;
    state.money-=repay;state.hidden.loanFromFriend=0;
    addLog(`新一週先把向朋友借的 ${repay} 元還掉。`);
  }
  state.energy=clamp(state.energy+8);state.fatigue=clamp(state.fatigue-8);state.stress=clamp(state.stress-2);
  if(state.habit?.trait==="pileup")state.stress=clamp(state.stress+2);
  addLog("星期一收到本週零用錢 300 元（若有預支或借款，先償還）。");
  toast("💰 新的一週：零用錢 +300");
  ensureWeekSetup();saveLocal(false);resumeFlow();
}

function scoreBreakdown(){
  const condition =
    (state.fatigue>=90?-10:state.fatigue>=80?-7:state.fatigue>=65?-4:state.fatigue>=50?-2:0) +
    (state.stats.mood<20?-7:state.stats.mood<35?-4:state.stats.mood<50?-1:0) +
    (state.stress>=80?-6:state.stress>=65?-3:0) +
    (state.energy<35?-5:state.energy<50?-2:0) +
    (state.stats.confidence<25?-4:state.stats.confidence<40?-2:0) +
    (state.sickTurns>0?-7:0);
  return {condition,absorption:learningAbsorption(),fatigue:Math.round(state.fatigue),mood:Math.round(state.stats.mood),stress:Math.round(state.stress)};
}
function ensureExamVariance(){
  if(state.examVariance)return;
  const r=()=>Math.floor(Math.random()*7)-3;
  state.examVariance={chinese:r(),english:r(),math:r(),science:r(),social:r()};
}
function calcScores(){
  ensureExamVariance();
  const b=scoreBreakdown();
  const one=sub=>{
    const mastery=state.mastery[sub];
    const prep=Math.min(3.5,state.prep[sub]||0);
    const variance=state.examVariance[sub]||0;
    return Math.round(clamp(mastery+prep+b.condition+variance,25,95));
  };
  const zh=one("chinese"),en=one("english"),ma=one("math"),sc=one("science"),so=one("social");
  return {國文:zh,英文:en,數學:ma,自然:sc,社會:so,平均:Math.round((zh+en+ma+sc+so)/5),breakdown:b};
}
function showExam(){
  if(!state.examEpilogueSeen){
    state.examEpilogueSeen=true;
    switchScreen('game');
    renderSide();
    unlock('bg_gate');
    activeEvent={label:"第一章｜考完之後",speaker:"旁白",bg:"bg_gate",cinematic:true};
    setVisual(activeEvent);
    setEventSceneMode("play");
    renderEventDataBar();
    document.getElementById("eventDataBar")?.classList.add("show");
    document.querySelector("#game .topbar")?.classList.remove("cinematicHidden");
    document.getElementById('speaker').textContent="旁白";
    document.getElementById('widget').innerHTML="";
    document.getElementById('story').textContent="鐘聲響了。\n\n有人立刻開始對答案，有人趴在桌上，也有人只想先去買杯飲料。\n\n你把筆收進鉛筆盒。這張考卷會有分數，但這七週留下來的，不只有分數。\n\n七週前，你第一次站在這個班的門口。現在，你已經做過很多只有自己才知道代價的選擇。";
    document.getElementById('hint').textContent="先不要急著看分數。回頭看看，這七週留下了什麼。";
    document.getElementById('choices').innerHTML='<button class="choice" onclick="setEventSceneMode(\'off\');showExamResults()"><div><span class="letter">01</span>看看這七週留下的結果</div><span class="adopt">繼續</span></button>';
    saveLocal(false);
    return;
  }
  showExamResults();
}
function showExamResults(){
  switchScreen('game'); renderSide(); unlock('bg_gate');
  const s=calcScores(),b=s.breakdown;
  let title="開始找到自己節奏的人";
  if(state.habit?.trait==="stable")title="慢慢建立穩定生活節奏的人";
  if(state.habit?.trait==="pileup")title="事情有點堆起來、正在學著拉回節奏的人";
  if(state.stats.social>=65 && state.habit?.trait!=="pileup")title="很重視關係，也在找自己節奏的人";
  if(state.sickTurns>
